subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose per-spawn `announceTarget: "parent"`, which suppresses normal external completion delivery and fails closed when the requester cannot be awakened?
rationale: Implementation correctness cannot decide whether agents should receive a model-facing control that can intentionally make completed work externally invisible; this is a lasting delivery-policy and compatibility choice.

options.title: Defer pending sponsorship
options.body: Close the technically complete PR now and reopen it when an owner explicitly sponsors the strict silent-parent delivery contract.

options.title: Sponsor the narrowed API
options.body: Reopen and land the per-spawn-only capability after an owner accepts its fail-closed delivery and persisted restart behavior.

options.title: Reject strict silence
options.body: Keep current parent-first completion handling and rely on the requester agent's normal reply or `NO_REPLY` decision instead of adding another routing policy.

recommendation.title: Defer pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close the technically complete PR now and reopen it when an owner explicitly sponsors the strict silent-parent delivery contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work crosses sessions_spawn, requester handoff, and subagent lifecycle behavior, making them the strongest available owner for this product-policy choice.
